tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshogs mchod bzhugs/ hoḥ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i mkha' dbyings las/ /thon pa'i 'dod dgu'i tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin/ /spros pa'i spyi 'dod dngos grub char 'bebs pa'i/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod rgya mtsho 'dis/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs/ /dngos brgyud drin can bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / na mo/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa= rtsa brgyud kyis dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta= ho bde stong = /thon pa'i= /spros pa'i= / zag med= /rgyud sde bzhi 'brel yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /dkon mchog rin chen rnam gsum mnyes phyir 'bul/ /brtse bas bzhes la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub da lta nyid du stsal du gsol/ / na mo thabs dang = yi dam lha tshogs rnams dang bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal du= bde stong = /thon pa'i= /spros pa'i= /zag med= /rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ / brtse ba'i= /dngos grub= / na mo thabs= rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du= bde stong= /thon pa'i= /spros= /zag med= /bka' sdod lcam dral chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /tshe ring mched lnga la sogs mnyes phyir 'bul/ brtse bas bzhes la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i gdong grogs mdzod/ na mo thabs dang = chos skyongs bsrung ma dang bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal du pañtsa= bde stong = /thon= /spros= /zag med= /'gro ba rigs drug lan chags snying rje'i mgron/ /ma gyur sems can thams cad tshim phyir bsngos/ /dgyes shing bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen yid bzhin bsgrubs/ / thabs dang = ma gyur sems can rnams kyis longs spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod pa'o yon tan lnga dang ldan pa zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/ ā ka ro sogs/ <'jug mi tshang*/> tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - 193-- 192-
